title: Inspect and extend: Hydrate local chat state and coordinate shared actions
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/store.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve asyncstorage adapter, load/save effects, context actions, and optimistic state.
problem: Context shares messages across views; storage restores a prior local snapshot. Follow startup hydration and then how sent messages are persisted after local insertion. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/store.ts` and the related project files: src/store.ts; src/chatContext.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to asyncstorage adapter, load/save effects, context actions, and optimistic state.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Local chat persistence is not end-to-end encrypted server sync.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Context shares messages across views; storage restores a prior local snapshot. Follow startup hydration and then how sent messages are persisted after local insertion.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/store.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
